title: Coder ledger: one JSON object per task attempt (JSONL, one line each)
description: One record = one coder attempting one task, from assignment to acceptance or abandonment. Coders run in sequential blocks (one model for a few tasks, then another model in a new session), so tasks differ between coders and the comparison is rough. Fields marked HARNESS come from Pi session logs, filled by the human when convenient, otherwise null; never by the coder. Fields marked REVIEWER are filled by the reviewer from the diff and test output. Fields marked HUMAN are filled by the human.

task_id.description: Stable ID for the task, e.g. S3-B1-03

run_id.description: Attempt number for this task; 1 unless the task is restarted from scratch

coder.description: Exact model ID as Pi reports it, e.g. claude-haiku-5-5, mimo-v2.6-flash

provider.description: HARNESS: Pi provider name, e.g. anthropic, xiaomi-tp

thinking_level.description: HARNESS: Pi thinking level in effect for the coder session

difficulty.description: REVIEWER, set at planning time, before the coder starts

allowed_scope.description: REVIEWER: file paths/globs the coder may touch, fixed at planning time

verification_commands.description: REVIEWER: commands the coder must run before claiming done

rounds.description: One entry per coder-to-reviewer cycle. A correction round is any round whose verdict is not 'accepted'.

coder_turns.description: HARNESS: model calls (assistant turns) in the coder's Pi session for this round

coder_active_s.description: HARNESS: seconds from coder receiving the task/feedback to coder stopping. Excludes relay gap.

review_active_s.description: HARNESS: seconds the reviewer spent on this round. Excludes relay gap.

relay_gap_s.description: HUMAN/HARNESS: idle time between agents in this round. Recorded for transparency, EXCLUDED from time_to_accept_s.

coder_tokens.description: HARNESS: summed from the coder's Pi session usage for this round

peak_context_tokens.description: HARNESS: largest prompt in the round, input + cache_read + cache_write on a single call. Target is under 100000.

cost_source.description: Where the cost came from, e.g. pi-estimate. Costs are approximate; compare coders by ratio, not absolute dollars.

findings.description: REVIEWER: issues found in THIS round's submission

id.description: e.g. F-1, unique within the task attempt

inherited.description: True when the defect comes from code written in an earlier task (possibly by another coder), not this submission. Inherited findings are excluded from this coder's weighted_findings.

description.description: One or two sentences, with file:line where possible

resolved_in_round.description: Round in which this was verified fixed; null if never

discipline.description: REVIEWER: mechanical checks against the diff and transcript. Count, do not judge.

out_of_scope_files.description: Files changed that are outside allowed_scope

unrequested_changes.description: Count of hunks that implement nothing the task asked for (refactors, renames, reformatting, extra features)

verification_run.description: Whether the required verification_commands were actually run, per transcript

constraint_violations.description: Plan constraints explicitly stated in the task spec that were violated

claim_mismatches.description: Statements in the coder's handoff that the diff or transcript contradicts

handoff_complete.description: Whether the handoff file followed the required format with all sections

notes.description: Free text, e.g. session restarted for context size

outcome.description: Rollup, filled when the task ends. Derived from rounds; do not edit independently.

rounds_to_accept.description: Total rounds including the accepting one; null if never accepted

time_to_accept_s.description: Sum over rounds of coder_active_s + review_active_s. relay_gap_s is excluded.

coder_cost_usd.description: Sum over ALL rounds including rejected ones

pipeline_cost_usd.description: coder_cost_usd + review_cost_usd summed over all rounds

weighted_findings.description: Sum of finding weights across all rounds, excluding inherited findings: blocker=8, major=4, minor=2, nit=1

discipline_flags.description: Total count of: out-of-scope files + unrequested_changes + constraint_violations + claim_mismatches + (1 per round where verification_run != 'all')

human_spot_check.description: HUMAN: independent check of the reviewer's verdict on a sample of tasks, to catch single-judge bias
